[Intro]
Eins, zwei, drei, alle!
[G]
[C]Ooooh,
[G]you cannot reach me
[C]now Ooo-
[G]oh, no matter how you
[C]try
[D]Goodbye, cruel world, it's
[C]over Walk on
[G]by.

[Verse 1]
[G]Sitting in a bunker
here behind my wall
[C]
[Am]Waiting for the
worms to come.
[C]
In
[G]perfect isolation
here behind my wall
[C]
[Am]Waiting for the
[G]worms, worms to
[C]come.

[Bridge]
[Am]Waiting to cut out the deadwood.
Waiting to clean up the city.
Waiting to [G]follow the
[Am]worms. Waiting to put on a black shirt.
Waiting to weed out the weaklings.
Waiting to smash in their windows And
kick in their doors. Waiting for the
final solution To strengthen the strain.
Waiting to [G]follow the
[Am]worms. Waiting to turn on the showers And
fire the ovens. Waiting for the
queens and the coons And the reds and the jews.
Waiting to [G]follow the
[Am]worms.

[Verse 2]
[G]Would you like to see
Britannia Rule again,
[C]my
friend?
[Am]All you have to do is
[G]follow the worms.
[Em]
[G]Would you like to send our
colored cousins Home again,
[C]my friend?
[Am]All you need to do is
[G]follow the worms

[Outro]
